player_prompt.intro:
Wee ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tuma mchezo wako kama **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = ni ubao mdogo gani unacheza
• *micro* = ni mraba gani ndani ya ubao mdogo huo
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka alama yako katika ubao mdogo wa 7, mraba wa 8, na
lazima mpinzani wako acheze katika ubao mdogo wa 8 ujao.

Wee ni `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Gũthiĩ no mũhaka gũkorũo kũrĩ [macro micro] na namba 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O mũtaratara ũbatiĩ gũkorũo ũrĩ gatagatĩ ka 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Gĩcunjĩ kĩa mĩgambo, rũtara kana gĩthũri kĩarĩ nja ya ũraihu.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Mũgambo ũcio no mũhaka ũhũrũo na kamũrango-inĩ karĩa gakinyaga.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: O na rĩu nĩ tũhootanĩte kĩharo-inĩ kĩu.

next_board.any: kĩbungo o gĩothe kĩa micro board

game_action.played: Mchezaji {player_id} alicheza katika ubao mdogo {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (safu {row}, safu wima {col}). Mchezaji {opponent_id} lazima sasa acheze katika {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mũthaaki {player_id} nĩ agaacinda Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
